chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Abān, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ibn Sinān, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

If blood affects a man's garment and he prays in it while he does not know, then there is no repetition upon him. But if he knew before praying, then forgot and prayed in it, then repetition is upon him.

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing worn during prayer
key_terms.الدَّمُ: blood, treated here as a ritual impurity affecting the validity of prayer conditions
key_terms.عَلِمَ: he knew of the impurity beforehand
key_terms.فَلَا إِعَادَةَ عَلَيْهِ: there is no obligation upon him to repeat the prayer
key_terms.لَا يَعْلَمُ: he was unaware of the impurity

ai.seo_question: Must salat be repeated if someone prayed in clothes stained with blood?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about praying in a garment stained with blood. If a person was unaware of the blood, the salat does not have to be repeated; but if he knew of it before the prayer and then forgot, he must repeat the prayer.
